_comment: Regression cases for pdf_points.py.  Paths are relative to tests/data.
expected  : CSV the program must reproduce
tolerance : maximum absolute difference allowed for numeric columns
columns   : only compare these columns (default: all columns of 'expected')
update    : false = hand-made reference, never overwritten by --update

schumpeter-001 default output

matplotlib: two panels, log y axis, marker XObjects

matplotlib: multi-page with page selection
effort-fig2: three Excel scatter plots, diamonds from four lines, inward ticks, packed TJ labels, sub-caption titles
